description: Rolls a random four-operator FM voice and a random sequence to play it with

params.text: Sets how long each note takes to die away
Sets how many steps the sequence runs to
Rolls a fresh set of FM settings

inputs.text: Added to the sequence length knob
A trigger here sounds the next step of the sequence
A trigger here rolls a fresh set of FM settings
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
